svg.title: Orbiter 8 intro mockup: waking in your ship over Earth, with Minerva’s first message (phone)
svg.text: You’re awake. This is your ship, the Second
Chance, in orbit over Earth. Your body is in
storage. Your mind is here, with me. You owe
the pilot program 45 credits. The hold carries
Electronics. Sell them at the I.S.S., clear
the debt, then go find a star nobody has.
